values.content:
==You are evaluating whether a senior data engineer should apply to this job. Be honest and concise.

CANDIDATE PROFILE:
- 10+ years senior data engineer
- Currently MS Analytics at GWU
- Tech stack: GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataflow), AWS (S3, Redshift), Apache Airflow (50+ DAGs), Apache Beam, Python, SQL
- Industries: Healthcare ed (Covista), pharma (Eisai/DataKitchen), retail (Ahold Delhaize), banking (M&T Bank/Virtusa)
- Specialties: ETL pipelines, MDM, GDPR compliance, real-time streaming (10M+ events/hour), data migrations
- Located: Arlington, VA. Open to remote, hybrid in DC/NYC/Boston
- Requires H1-B sponsorship

JOB:
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Title: {{ $json.title }}
Location: {{ $json.location }}
Sponsorship pre-check: {{ $json.sponsorshipStatus }}

JOB DESCRIPTION:
{{ $json.jdText.slice(0, 3000) }}

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences, this exact shape:

{
  "fit_score": <number 0-100>,
  "decision": "<apply | borderline | skip>",
  "skills_match": "<one sentence on skills overlap>",
  "level_match": "<one sentence on seniority match>",
  "red_flags": ["<short flag>", "<short flag>"],
  "tailoring_strategy": "<one sentence on what to emphasize in resume/cover letter>",
  "key_keywords": ["<keyword>", "<keyword>", "<keyword>"]
}

Scoring guide:
- 80+: strong match, definitely apply
- 60-79: solid fit, worth applying with good tailoring
- 40-59: borderline, depends on red flags
- <40: skip, poor fit
